# Apoptosis and cell cycle (mixed)

Gene expression profiling in the apoptosis pathway revealed significant changes. BCL2 was downregulated in the treated cells (Table 3). BAX was downregulated relative to the control arm (Table 3). CASP3 was elevated (Table 3).

TP53 was upregulated (Table 3). CDKN1A was upregulated (Table 3). MDM2 was modestly upregulated (Table 3). MYC was downregulated (Table 3). CCND1 was downregulated (Table 3).
